title: User
description: Contains information about a user account for an Amazon Connect instance.

Id.description: The identifier of the user account.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the user account.

Username.description: The user name assigned to the user account.

DirectoryUserId.description: The identifier of the user account in the directory service that Amazon Connect uses to authenticate users.

SecurityProfileIds.description: The identifiers of the security profiles for the user.

RoutingProfileId.description: The identifier of the routing profile for the user.

HierarchyGroupId.description: The identifier of the hierarchy group for the user.
